summary: Customer requests an in-line optical measurement during yeast fermentation to follow growth and detect changes earlier. Biomass and metabolic signals are mentioned but not defined as separate targets. The broth becomes more optically dense over the run. They seek an initial feasibility study with reference measurements.

facts_stated.text: Purpose is to follow growth and notice changes earlier.
